offer.text: The chronicle is finished, and I want it shared, not shelved. Bring 3 bookshelves and we'll open a reading room for the whole village.

accept.text: A library the village can call its own — at last!

decline.text: Knowledge hoarded is knowledge lost. But as you wish.

in_progress.text: Are the shelves on their way?

ready.text: Three shelves — the reading room is ready to open!

complete.text: Generations will read what we made together. Take this, with my deepest thanks — and my friendship.
